Coverage charts for one geography

Source: R/page-national_coverage--coverage.R
coverage_ui.Rd

The body of the national and sub-national coverage pages: one card of charts with a tab for each indicator the app lists (cd_cfg("nat_cov_indicators")) and a Custom tab for any other analysis indicator. A tab plots the indicator's coverage by year from the health facility data, with the denominator selected for that indicator, beside the survey and WUENIC estimates. It reads the dataset's get_filtered_coverage(), which takes the indicator's rows from calculate_coverage() for the admin level and region. The tab "fpet", when an app lists it, shows the family planning estimates instead (cache()$fpet_data, from 2010 onwards). The piece has no filters of its own: the page gives it the admin level and region.

Usage

coverage_ui(id, i18n, key_label)

coverage_server(
  id,
  cache,
  i18n,
  admin_level,
  region = reactive(NULL),
  active = reactive(TRUE)
)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

key_label

The translation key of the card's title.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

admin_level

A reactive that returns the level the coverage is worked out at: "national", "adminlevel_1" (admin level 1) or "district".

region

A reactive that returns the name of the region (or district) to show, or NULL for none.

active

A reactive that is TRUE once the page has been opened with data loaded. The charts do no work before that.

Value

coverage_ui() returns the card's UI as Shiny tags. coverage_server() returns a reactive that holds the key of the tab shown: an indicator's name, or "custom".

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# the charts in a page module, at national level
my_page_ui <- function(id, i18n) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  cd_page_ui(id, i18n, coverage_ui(ns("body"), i18n, "title_coverage_national"))
}
my_page_server <- function(id, cache, i18n, active = reactive(TRUE)) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    coverage_server("body", cache, i18n, reactive("national"), active = active)
  })
}

# for one region: the admin level and the region are reactives
coverage_server("body", cache, i18n, reactive("adminlevel_1"), reactive("Nairobi"), active = active)
} # }
